changes_before_reexecution: Add a sealed typed per-task M470 compact sidecar during the same single derivative traversal.
Correct every macro-rounded record width: 640-byte stored PWP uses 36 144-bit slices, 576-byte lazy center uses 32, a 384-byte four-block weight row uses 22, and each 96-byte config slot uses 6.
Require macro-rounded bytes to be no smaller than logical bytes for every memory item.
Apply the same exact-empty gate before config and payload fetch to strong-zero, stored-PWP and lazy-PWP; cycle and traffic ledgers are synchronized.
Restore the strong-zero first-preprocess plus current-work/next-preprocess overlap sequence independently for every sample/operator/row-tile and four-bank half pass.

objective: Run a fair exact sample->operator->row-tile->432-partition DSE, including non-free lazy PWP generation and honest 144-bit/depth-64 SRAM rounding, while producing an M470-ready task sidecar without rereading the M410R2 derivative.

paper_identity.runtime_population: M40 frozen S10 zurich_city_09_a exposed only through the M410R2 sealed original16 derivative
paper_identity.catalog_population: M73 disjoint DSEC train-only S32 over 18 sequences

schedule_contract.order: sample -> operator -> row_tile -> partition[0..431] -> operator/tile commit -> psum reset
schedule_contract.exact_empty_gate: All three modes pay only active-bitmap/popcount scan plus tail when the task is empty; no config, weight or PWP DMA is issued.
schedule_contract.psum_residency: The resident block banks remain across all 432 partitions and commit once per row tile; no intermediate off-chip psum spill.

block_bank_axis.8: One source/config/matcher traversal and two distinct four-block payload/replay halves.
block_bank_axis.4: Two full 432-partition half passes. Source/config/matcher repeat twice; distinct half payload bytes sum naturally; four psum banks reside.

cycle_model.strong_zero_overlap: For each physical partition sequence: first preprocess + sum(max(current work,next preprocess)+tail). Four-bank halves are separate sequences.
cycle_model.stored_eight_bank_overlap: Half1 DMA may overlap half0 replay exactly as M468R2.
cycle_model.lazy_headline_schedule: Weight DMA, generation and replay are serial.
cycle_model.lazy_upper_bound_diagnostic: Eight-bank only double-buffer overlap is non-headline.

lazy_generator_contract.cycles_per_center_per_half: 1 setup + 4*ceil(popcount(center)/K), plus a charged half flush
lazy_generator_contract.reuse: Within one task/output half only; no cross-partition, row-tile, operator or sample reuse.
lazy_generator_contract.port_schedule: Shared weight read/PWP write port serializes headline generation and replay.

capacity_contract.rounded_gate: Every live memory is 144-bit sliced and depth rounded to 64; every rounded item must be >= its logical item; total plus reserve <=240 KiB.
capacity_contract.psum: resident_block_banks independent 96x19-bit records per row; thirteen slices per block bank
capacity_contract.valid_active: one active bit per row and resident_block_banks valid bits per row
capacity_contract.source_descriptor: two 16-bit source slots and two 48-bit descriptor slots including actual row tags
capacity_contract.config: two 768-bit records, each six slices at depth64
capacity_contract.weight: one record is four blocks*96 lanes*INT8=3072 bits, twenty-two slices, sixteen rows rounded to depth64
capacity_contract.stored_pwp: one record is padded640B=5120 bits, thirty-six slices, centers rounded to depth64
capacity_contract.lazy_center: one record is 576B=4608 bits, thirty-two slices, centers rounded to depth64; serial headline reuses one buffer, overlap diagnostic separately adds a second

m470_task_sidecar.format: compressed NPZ with typed arrays and allow_pickle-free contents
m470_task_sidecar.purpose: Next M470 may cache P partition payloads across row tiles and charge full 5.472 MiB psum spill/reload at window boundaries. No M470 benefit is modeled here.

materiality_rule.vs_best_same_budget_strong_zero: >=1.15x at 128 B/cycle and both capacity gates, where the zero baseline independently selects its minimum-cycle row tile under the same resident-block-bank axis and 240 KiB gates
materiality_rule.lazy_vs_best_same_budget_stored_pwp: >=1.10x, where stored-PWP independently selects its minimum-cycle row tile under the same resident-block-bank axis, bandwidth and 240 KiB gates
materiality_rule.same_tile_comparisons: Retain only as mechanism ablations; neither same-tile zero nor same-tile stored controls material admission.
materiality_rule.admission: CPU DSE remains performance_admitted=false pending independent hammer and implementation.
